title: My Fake Boyfriend
description: One fake date becomes the biggest rumor in school. And maybe something more.

seasons.title: The Rumor Mill
seasons.description: High school drama at its best.

parts.text: She just needed a date for the dance. Any date. Even if it was the school's most notorious troublemaker.
He leaned against the locker, a smirk playing on his lips. "So, you want me to be your boyfriend? That's going to cost you."
She didn't realize the cost would be her heart.
